CommunityApplications.Profile: Zilcho Labs makes small, self-hosted media tools. This repository holds Zilcho Subs, which makes subtitles and song lyrics for your own media library on your own server: subtitles from speech with a local Whisper model, offline translation, translation of existing .srt files, and line- or word-synced .lrc lyrics. It runs on the CPU and uploads nothing to a cloud service. For help, bug reports and feature requests, open an issue at https://github.com/Zilcho-Labs/zilcho-subs/issues
